grammar.title: 语法知识 现在完成&一般过去
lines: 8 Have you ever had a girlfriend? Yes. 引起话题:你有没有交过女朋友？ Have you ever…? 引起新的话题 Have you ever made a foreign friend. 你有没有交过外国朋友？ Have you ever cheated on exams. 你考试有没有做过弊？
现在完成时 (Present Perfect) 一般过去时 (Simple Past)
强调“已经”，分为全部完成、部分完成，影响到了现在。 过去发生的动作、状态。
主语 + have/has + done (过去 分词 ) 主语 + have/has + been + 非动词 主语 + did ( 过去式 ) 主语 + was/were + 非动词
I have lived in this city for five years. I have been there. I lived in this city when I was a child. He was a boy.
过去发生， 影响现在 过去发生，与 现在无关
just, already, before, never, ever, yet…（时间 含糊 ） yesterday, last…,…ago, just now…（时间 具体 ）
语用功能:引起一个话题 语用功能:具体谈论
When did you…? 什么时候...?
一般过去时 现在完成时
I went to Britain last year . 我去年去了英国。 I have been to Britain. 我已经去过英国啦！
He wrote a book last month . 他上个月写了一本书。 He has written five books. 他到现在为止写了五本书了！

sentences.title: 单词句型 现在完成&一般过去的区分
lines: 现在完成时 一般过去时
She has just (现在完成时的标志) boiled an egg. She boiled it a minute ago .
She has never been to China, but he was there in… He painted it a week ago .
He has already painted that bookcase. She emptied the basket this morning .
He has just dusted the cupboard. He dusted the cupboard yesterday .
